Facility Operations Maintenance

  • Security Administration: Oversee SAP user and role administration, system security, and compliance with audit requirements. Manage authorisations and implement security patches.

  • Performance Optimisation: Conduct regular performance analysis of SAP systems, databases, and interfaces. Recommend and implement tuning measures.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials for L1 and L2 teams.

jobDescription:
AWS Connect Engineer Role Summary:
We are looking for an AWS Connect Engineer who can both design and operate the Amazon Connect contact center and build the reporting and analytics that leadership relies on. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building IVR/contact flows and AI-assisted quality evaluation as they are writing SQL against the analytics data lake and standing up automated daily reports. You will own the Connect platform end-to-end - configuration, routing, integrations, quality, and metrics - for a multi-tower service desk operating across queues such as TSD-L1, TSD-L2, Clinical Service Desk, and Enhanced/C-Suite support.

What makes this role different
This is not a config-only role. You will also produce the numbers leadership acts on - calls offered/answered, ASA, AHT, service levels, and a defensible true-abandonment figure - using Connect metrics, the analytics data lake, and automated reporting. Strong SQL and AWS reporting skills are as important as Connect configuration.

Key Responsibilities
A. Amazon Connect - Design & Configuration
Contact flows & IVR: design, build, and maintain inbound flows, IVR menus, prompts (S3 / TTS / SSML), hours of operation, holidays, and error handling
Routing: configure queues, routing profiles, quick connects, and multi-queue fallback/overflow logic (e.g., mutual fallback between towers)
Agent experience: manage security profiles, users, agent hierarchies, and the Contact Control Panel / agent workspace
Data Tables & dynamic config: use Amazon Connect Data Tables for no-code operational changes such as outage announcements, holiday flags, and dynamic prompts
Telephony: claim and manage DIDs / toll-free numbers; coordinate carrier and number porting where required

B. Quality, AI & Contact Lens
Contact Lens: enable and configure conversational analytics (post-call), category rules, sentiment, and redaction
Evaluation forms: build and maintain agent evaluation forms, including generative-AI (automated) scoring and rule-based automation
QA operations: support calibration between AI and human reviewers; tune evaluation logic and thresholds

C. Integrations
ITSM: integrate Connect with ServiceNow (screen-pop, ticket create/update, resolver-group routing)
Identity & collaboration: work with Active Directory / Entra ID and Microsoft Teams as applicable
Serverless glue: build and maintain AWS Lambda functions used within flows and for automation

D. Reporting, Metrics & Analytics (equal priority)
Built-in reporting: create, schedule, and maintain historical & real-time metrics reports; configure S3 export and scheduled delivery
Metrics APIs: use GetMetricDataV2 to programmatically pull queue/agent metrics (service level thresholds, ASA, AHT, abandonment) at custom intervals and time zones
Analytics Data Lake / Athena: enable the Connect analytics data lake; write Athena (Presto/Trino) SQL against contact_record / contact_statistic_record for contact-level accuracy - including true-abandonment logic using Agent Connection Attempts
Automated distribution: build serverless pipelines (EventBridge Lambda SES / SNS) to compute KPIs and email daily/weekly reports; land data in S3
BI dashboards: prepare data for and support Amazon QuickSight and/or Power BI dashboards; ensure clean, model-ready datasets
Metric integrity: understand nuanced Connect metric behavior (e.g., contacts handled vs. queued, agent non-response vs. customer abandon) and produce numbers that reconcile and are defensible to leadership

E. Operations & Governance
Stabilization & go-live: support go-live ramp-up, monitoring, and post-go-live stabilization
Change management: follow least-privilege and change-control practices; document configurations and runbooks
Stakeholder support: translate business/operational needs into Connect configuration and reporting; present results clearly to PMO and C-level stakeholders

Required Skills & Experience
Amazon Connect (must-have)
Hands-on building Amazon Connect contact flows, routing profiles, queues, and IVR
Contact Lens, evaluation forms, and quality-management configuration
Amazon Connect Data Tables, prompts (SSML/TTS), hours of operation, and quick connects
Experience with queue fallback/overflow and multi-tower routing designs
AWS platform & reporting (must-have)
Strong SQL - able to write and optimize analytical queries (Athena / Presto-Trino preferred)
AWS Lambda (Python or Node.js), IAM (least-privilege policies), Amazon S3
Amazon Connect metrics: GetMetricDataV2 / historical & real-time reports; metric definitions
Amazon EventBridge (scheduling) and Amazon SES/SNS for automated report delivery
Amazon Connect analytics data lake / AWS Glue / Lake Formation exposure
BI tooling - Amazon QuickSight and/or Microsoft Power BI
Comfortable in advanced Excel for data validation and ad-hoc analysis
Integrations & tooling (strong plus)
ServiceNow integration with Connect (CTI, screen-pop, incident automation)
AWS CLI / CloudFormation or Terraform for repeatable deployments
Amazon Lex (chatbot) and Kinesis (CTR streaming) exposure
Active Directory / Entra ID, Microsoft Teams

Soft skills
Clear communicator who can explain metrics and trade-offs to non-technical leadership
Detail-oriented and accuracy-driven; validates numbers before they are reported
Comfortable working across locations and time zones with PMO governance

Preferred Qualifications
Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect - Associate; any Amazon Connect specialty training
Domain: prior work in IT Service Desk / ITIL environments or healthcare contact centers
Education: Bachelors in computer science, IT, or equivalent practical experience

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
Owns and documents the existing Connect configuration (flows, queues, routing, evaluation forms)
Delivers a reliable daily/weekly KPI report (offered, answered, ASA, AHT, true-abandon %) that reconciles and is trusted by leadership
Stands up or stabilizes the automated reporting pipeline (data lake / Lambda / scheduled delivery)
Implements at least one operational improvement (e.g., outage-announcement via Data Tables, routing optimization, or AI evaluation tuning)

How to evaluate candidates (for the hiring panel)
- Ask them to whiteboard a contact flow with multi-queue fallback and an outage announcement.
- Give a SQL scenario: compute true abandonment (customer disconnected in queue, no agent connected) from contact records.
- Probe metric nuance: why can contacts handled exceed contacts queued , and how they d report a defensible abandon rate.
- Ask how they d schedule and email a daily report without manual effort (EventBridge Lambda SES).

The role will focus on protecting agent-to-tool and agent-to-agent interactions through strong authorization, identity, credential management, and gateway enforcement mechanisms.

The role focuses on session and context persistence, memory APIs, isolation and scoping patterns, and Python-based platform components that allow agents to use memory consistently with minimal custom implementation.
What project we have for you
About the Client
Our client is a large global enterprise operating across multiple markets, with a complex technology landscape and a strong focus on digital transformation and innovation. The organization is actively investing in modern cloud, data, and AI capabilities to enable scalable, secure, and highly automated solutions across its business.

tagsAndSkills: automotive safety,continuous integration,code coverage,debug,communication protocols,ai,computer engineering,automotive functional safety
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Design Verification Engineer
Automotive Connectivity SoCs and E2B Technology
As a Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will develop verification environments and execute verification activities for next-generation automotive connectivity SoCs based on E2B technology.
You will work on complex devices incorporating embedded processors, digital communication subsystems, firmware, security functions, and mixed-signal components. Working with moderate supervision, you will collaborate with design, architecture, firmware, functional safety, and validation teams to ensure that designs meet their functional, quality, and reliability requirements before tape-out.
You will contribute to SystemVerilog/UVM testbench development, C DPI integration, coverage analysis, regression execution, and debugging of hardware-software interactions. This position provides an opportunity to develop expertise in automotive SoC verification while contributing to technologies that enable reliable, high-performance in-vehicle connectivity.


Key Responsibilities
  • Verification Environment Development: Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, including agents, sequences, monitors, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, and functional coverage.
  • SoC Verification: Verify SoC functionality involving embedded processors, memories, interconnects, interrupts, DMA controllers, peripherals, communication interfaces, and mixed-signal subsystems.
  • Verification Planning: Contribute to verification plans by translating design and product requirements into test scenarios, coverage items, and verification objectives.
  • Test Development: Develop directed and constrained-random tests for block-level, subsystem-level, and SoC-level verification.
  • Processor-Based Verification: Develop and execute verification scenarios for microprocessor-based SoCs, including processor initialization, register accesses, interrupts, exceptions, boot sequences, and basic firmware interactions.
  • C DPI Integration: Develop and maintain C/SystemVerilog DPI interfaces and integrate C-based models or reference functions into simulation environments.
  • E2B Functionality: Verify E2B communication functionality, including configuration, control, data transfer, timing behavior, error handling, diagnostics, and recovery scenarios.
  • Coverage and Metrics: Analyze functional, code, and assertion coverage; identify verification gaps; and develop additional tests to support verification closure.
  • Regression Execution: Execute and monitor verification regressions, analyze failures, classify issues, and communicate results to the project team.
  • Debugging: Analyze and resolve verification failures across testbenches, RTL, embedded C code, reference models, and system-level scenarios.
  • Functional Safety Support: Contribute to verification of automotive safety mechanisms, fault injection tests, requirements traceability, and verification evidence for ISO 26262-related activities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with design, architecture, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams to resolve technical issues and support project milestones.

title: Manager- Platform Engineering
jobDescription:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vistas presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

About Amtech

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition
At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:
Purpose
Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.
Growth
Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.
Culture
Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.
Innovation
Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

Role Description

Amtech is executing an all-in AWS strategy: migrating our flagship Encore ERP to a multi-account, account-per-customer AWS architecture, operating LabelTraxx as a multi-tenant SaaS platform, and retiring legacy private-cloud infrastructure over time. Platform Engineering owns the landing zone, infrastructure as code, and the golden-path tooling that product teams build on, and the reliability of everything that runs on it.

The Manager, Platform Engineering (India) leads the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams: the engineers who build the AWS platform and the engineers who keep it running. You own the people, the delivery, and the day-to-day technical leadership of that group under the guidance of the VP, working alongside the Cloud Architect, who owns platform architecture. The scope spans two engineering disciplines and a direct interface to IT/IS/PE leadership and vendors.

This is a player-coach role by design: leadership first, hands-on second. Leadership means hiring and building the team, developing engineers, running the operating cadence, and representing Platform Engineering within IT/IS/PE and to partner functions. Hands-on means staying close enough to the code and the incidents to make good calls, review the changes that matter most, and lead incident response in India hours. As the team matures, the balance shifts further toward leadership without leaving the technical work behind.

You will work daily with the U.S.-based Senior Manager who leads Customer SRE, the Senior SRE who owns the reliability standards both SRE teams operate on, the Sr. Director of Information Security, and the VP. This role is the first people-leadership position in Platform Engineering India.

SCOPE & AUTHORITY

  • Leads hiring for the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams in partnership with Talent Acquisition; offers follow Amtech's approval process. The role leads interviews and makes the hiring recommendation for each open India position.
  • Owns performance, leveling, and development decisions for direct reports within Amtech's leveling framework.
  • Sets sprint priorities and capacity allocation for the India teams within the Platform Engineering roadmap.
  • Holds incident command for platform incidents in India hours.
  • Runs the architecture review and holds the team to its outcomes; the Cloud Architect approves architecture decisions, and decisions affecting security controls require Information Security sign-off.
  • Leads technical evaluation of platform vendors and tooling with the Cloud Architect; recommends spend and contract changes to the VP, who holds approval.
  • Participates in the IT/IS/PE leadership team as needed; Platform Engineering's representative in India site leadership forums.

JOB DESCRIPTION

People Leadership

  • Lead, hire, and develop the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams, a team that is growing through 2027 with hosted customer count and product engineering headcount and that this role hires into from day one.
  • Own performance management, career development, and leveling under Amtech's leveling framework; grow senior engineers into technical leads and future managers.
  • Set the operating cadence for the India teams: sprint ceremonies, on-call rotations, triage duty, and the follow-the-sun handoff with the U.S.
  • Build a team culture of ownership, blameless postmortems, and written decision-making that holds across time zones.
  • Give engineers credit publicly and feedback privately.

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Deliver the AWS platform roadmap set with the Cloud Architect, who owns architecture: multi-account organization, landing zone, networking, identity, and the account-per-customer Encore tenancy model.
  • Plan and deliver Encore-on-AWS environment builds (temporary, production, demo) on the shared golden IaC stack, and LabelTraxx platform work, against the roadmap.
  • Run the architecture review: decisions are recorded as ADRs, reviewed with the Senior SRE, and approved by the Cloud Architect. Make sure decisions are made on time and carried through by the team.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging capabilities, including AI-assisted and agentic engineering tooling, within Amtech's AI governance guardrails.

Platform Engineering & Delivery

  • Hold the technical bar for infrastructure code: enforce module standards set with the Cloud Architect, review the highest-blast-radius changes, and write code where it unblocks the team.
  • Operate and enforce standards for CI/CD (GitHub Actions), progressive delivery, environment promotion, and secrets management.
  • Drive automation of environment provisioning so a new hosted customer is a pipeline run, not a project; publish and hit onboarding time targets.
  • Own delivery against the Platform Engineering roadmap: sprint commitments, capacity budgets (strategic versus tactical), and the response commitments made to requesters.

Reliability & Operations

  • Own delivery of production reliability for the shared platform in India hours, operating on the SLO frameworks, observability architecture (OpenTelemetry, OpenObserve, CloudWatch), and PagerDuty service models set by the Senior SRE.
  • Hold authority to deviate from a reliability standard during an active incident, restore the standard when the incident closes, and raise a postmortem item to ratify or revert the change. Propose standard changes to the Senior SRE, who decides; the VP arbitrates.
  • Lead major incident response for platform incidents in India hours; own postmortems and the remediation backlog.
  • Own patching, backup and restore testing, disaster recovery exercises, and capacity management on a published calendar.
  • Extend observability to AI workloads so usage, performance, and spend are visible in the same plane as compute.

Security, Compliance & Cost

  • Implement and enforce security architecture with Information Security and the Cloud Architect: IAM boundaries, network segmentation, encryption, and data governance for customer data.
  • Ensure the platform satisfies SOC 2 and ISO 27001 obligations by design, with audit evidence generated through automation.
  • Drive FinOps outcomes with Finance: tagging governance, right-sizing, Savings Plans coverage, unit cost visibility, and input to the AWS enterprise commit.
  • Surface technical and delivery risk to the VP early: sequencing, vendor dependencies, and single points of failure.

AI Competency

  • Adopt agentic and AI-assisted engineering workflows for the team within the autonomy tiers, guardrails, and auditability set by Platform Engineering; measure productivity against baselines.
  • Apply the validation layers (schema, rules, model-graded, human review) appropriate to each change by blast radius.
  • Prevent AI-generated code from degrading platform quality at fleet scale: evaluation harnesses, complexity metrics, and AI-attributed defect tracking.
  • Mentor engineers in safe, high-leverage AI usage; enforce data classification policy in all AI-assisted work.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with the Customer SRE leader so the platform the India team builds and the environments Customer SRE runs evolve together.
  • Partner with the Senior SRE on reliability standards: implement and enforce them in India and feed operational learning back.
  • Serve as senior technical counterpart to AWS, consulting partners, and third-party providers on funded programs in India hours.
  • Report team delivery, reliability, and risk clearly to IT/IS/PE leadership; support integration work for acquisitions.

Ensure knowledge is durable: documentation, runbooks, and deliberate succession planning so no platform capability depends on one person, including you

WORKING HOURS

Core hours are India business hours. The role carries a scheduled overlap window with U.S. leadership for architecture reviews and leadership syncs, set in the team operating cadence. Incident command applies in India hours; weekend paging is P0 only and rotates across the team rather than resting on this role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Must have

  • Hands-on AWS platform experience in a multi-account environment: landing zones, account vending, IAM, and networking, at a level that lets you review your team's work credibly.
  • Strong Terraform and IaC experience: working in a shared module ecosystem with testing and versioning discipline.
  • 2+ years leading engineers as a people manager with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and development, within 12+ years of progressive engineering experience.
  • Experience leading production operations under SLOs: on-call design, incident command, postmortems, and observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent.

Strongly preferred

  • Designed AI-assisted or agentic engineering systems with guardrails, autonomy tiers, and measured ROI; L4+ AI competency by industry frameworks.
  • Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Go, or similar) and fluency with modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
  • Working command of cloud security architecture and compliance-driven design (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

Preferred

  • Track record of building and retaining a high-performing engineering team in a distributed, multi-time-zone organization.
  • Communicates decisions in writing clearly enough that executives act on them and engineers execute them without a meeting.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and account-per-customer tenancy economics.
  • Experience architecting and executing large migrations (data center or private cloud to AWS), including ERP-class or other stateful enterprise workloads.
  • Experience in a private equity portfolio company, M&A integration, or investor-facing technical diligence.
  • Experience building an engineering team in India for a U.S.-headquartered company, including leveling frameworks and retention programs.
  • FinOps practice experience: tagging governance, Savings Plans strategy, cost allocation, enterprise commit negotiation.
  • Experience establishing AI/LLM platform capabilities or agent-based automation under formal governance.

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST YEAR

  • Every India Cloud and Platform SRE engineer has a named manager, a leveled role, a development plan, and a clear on-call and triage rotation.
  • The golden IaC stack has a documented owner and a succession plan; no platform capability depends on one person.
  • New hosted customer environment provisioning time is published and improving quarter over quarter.
  • SLO attainment for the shared platform is published monthly and meets target; platform incidents in India hours are led, resolved, and written up to the standard the Senior SRE sets for both SRE teams.
  • The AWS enterprise commit is negotiated from a known baseline with FinOps discipline behind it.
  • The team is one you would be proud to hand to the manager you are developing to replace you.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: Platform Engineer
jobDescription:
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Platform Engineer with hands-on expertise in Software Engineering Intelligence (SEI) platforms, engineering data integrations, connector configuration, and platform evaluation.
The candidate will be responsible for configuring and maintaining integrations across Git repositories, work-tracking platforms, and CI/CD systems, ensuring that engineering data is accurately collected, correlated, and made available for analytics and productivity insights.
A key aspect of this role is the ability to perform identity resolution across multiple engineering systems, ensuring that users, teams, repositories, work items, and delivery activities can be accurately associated across disparate data sources. The candidate will also support structured Proofs of Concept (PoCs), data validation, platform evaluations, and integration assessments.

Key Responsibilities
SEI Platform Administration Engineering
    • Configure, administer, and support Software Engineering Intelligence (SEI) platforms used for engineering productivity and delivery analytics.
    • Manage platform configuration, connectors, integrations, users, teams, and engineering data sources.
    • Work with engineering teams to onboard and configure new data sources and maintain existing integrations.
    • Monitor connector health, data ingestion, synchronization, and platform data quality.
    • Troubleshoot integration, connectivity, authentication, and data ingestion issues.
Connector Integration Management
    • Configure and maintain connectors across:
    • Git / source-code management platforms
    • Work-tracking systems
    • CI/CD platforms
    • Integrate engineering systems to ensure reliable collection of source-code, work-item, build, deployment, and delivery data.
    • Understand source-system data models and map relevant engineering data into the SEI platform.
    • Validate connector configurations and troubleshoot data synchronization issues.
    • Work with API-based integrations where native connectors are unavailable or require customization.
    • Support onboarding of new engineering teams, repositories, projects, and pipelines into the platform.
Identity Resolution Data Correlation
    • Implement and maintain identity resolution across multiple engineering systems.
    • Map and reconcile user identities across Git, work-tracking, CI/CD, and other engineering platforms.
    • Investigate duplicate, missing, or incorrectly mapped identities and resolve data inconsistencies.
    • Ensure accurate association of users, teams, repositories, work items, commits, builds, and deployments.
    • Establish processes for maintaining identity mappings as teams, users, and organizational structures change.
Platform Evaluation Proofs of Concept
    • Support and lead structured Proofs of Concept (PoCs) for SEI and engineering productivity platforms.
    • Define PoC objectives, evaluation criteria, data requirements, and success metrics.
    • Configure connectors and data sources required for platform evaluations.
    • Validate the quality, completeness, accuracy, and usability of platform-generated engineering data.
    • Perform comparative analysis of platform capabilities and data outputs.
    • Document PoC findings, limitations, observations, and recommendations for stakeholders.
    • Work with vendors and internal engineering teams during product evaluations and technical workshops.
Data Validation Quality
    • Perform structured validation of engineering data collected from source systems.
    • Reconcile data between source systems and SEI platforms to identify discrepancies.
    • Validate metrics related to development activity, work tracking, builds, deployments, and engineering workflows.
    • Investigate data anomalies and work with platform or source-system teams to resolve underlying issues.
    • Establish repeatable data validation and quality-check processes.
AI Coding Assistant Telemetry

    • Work with engineering productivity platforms to understand usage and activity data generated by tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor.
    • Assist in evaluating how AI coding-assistant telemetry can be incorporated into engineering productivity and developer-experience analytics.
    • Validate telemetry data and ensure appropriate mapping to engineering users, teams, and projects.
Data Platform Integration
    • Support the extraction and downstream consumption of SEI platform data for enterprise analytics.
    • Work with platform exports and APIs to make engineering productivity data available to enterprise data platforms.
    • Support integration of SEI data into a Databricks lakehouse or similar enterprise data environment.
    • Work with Data Engineering teams to validate schemas, data mappings, ingestion processes, and data quality.
    • Document data flows between SEI platforms, engineering systems, and downstream analytics platforms.
Stakeholder Collaboration
    • Collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, Data Engineering, Product, and vendor teams.
    • Gather technical requirements for new integrations and platform capabilities.
    • Communicate integration status, data-quality issues, PoC findings, and platform risks to stakeholders.
    • Support technical demonstrations and platform evaluation sessions.
    • Provide technical documentation covering connectors, integrations, identity mappings, data flows, and operational procedures.

Required Skills Experience

title: Principal software Engineer
jobDescription:
Principal software Engineer


[GC1.1]

Overview
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Forward Deployed Engineer to accelerate delivery across Mastercard Services. Modeled on the forward deployed engineering role that leading technology companies embed alongside their most important customers, this position turns that model inward. You will deploy into Services programs as an internal partner who writes production code, unblocks delivery, and puts AI to work in how we build. Reporting to the SVP of Developer Enablement within the Services Enablement Transformation (SET) organization, you will move to wherever the need is greatest, adding senior engineering capacity during critical spikes, accelerating roadmaps, and helping teams adopt modern, AI-first practices.

Role
The Principal Forward Deployed Engineer is a senior individual contributor who deploys into Services teams to deliver working software and durable capability. Engagements are deliberately fluid. Some last few weeks to help a team ship a critical feature or clear a bottleneck, while others run longer to stand up a capability a program is missing. In every engagement you write production code, pair with the teams engineers, put AI to work in how they build, and leave the team faster and more capable than you found it.
Deliver Where Its Needed Most
- Embed directly into Services product and engineering teams, writing production-quality code and shipping features alongside them.
- Provide surge engineering capacity during critical delivery spikes, helping programs accelerate roadmaps and hit high-stakes milestones without permanently expanding headcount.
- Diagnose and clear technical bottlenecks across architecture, performance, integration, tooling, and delivery process.
- Fill short-term gaps with deep expertise, standing up new capabilities, and transferring them cleanly to the product team.
- Move fluidly across Services as priorities shift, scoping each engagement with program leaders and Developer Enablement so effort lands where it matters most.
Engineer AI Into How Services Builds
- Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions such as assistants, agents, and multi-agent workflows that solve real problems inside Services programs.
- Apply modern AI engineering practices, including LLMs, RAG, and agent frameworks, along with the evaluation, observability, and governance needed to run them safely in production.
- Mature AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, including AI-assisted coding, testing, code review, and release.
- Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and turn them into reusable patterns and reference implementations that Services teams can adopt.
Upskill Teams and Scale What Works
- Coach teams on AI-first ways of working through hands-on delivery, including pairing, prompt engineering, and agent design.
- Leave every team more self-sufficient than you found it, emphasizing documentation and knowledge transfer, so programs do not stay dependent on you.
- Carry patterns, friction points, and reusable solutions back from the field to inform Services-wide enablement, tooling, and golden paths.
- Partner with enterprise architecture, platform, and developer enablement teams so what you deliver aligns with Mastercard standards and scales beyond a single program.
Your impact shows up in the teams you leave behind. The programs you support ship faster, more of Services builds with AI because you showed them how, and the engineers you coach can keep building after you move on. You also leave behind reusable AI patterns and reference implementations that other teams can pick up and run with.

All About You
The ideal candidate is a seasoned, hands-on engineer who thrives on variety, moves fast, and measures success by outcomes delivered and teams left stronger. Specifically, you bring:
- Extensive hands-on software engineering experience at a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer level, with a track record of personal shipping complex, production-grade systems.
- Advanced experience overseeing containerization and orchestration architectures (Docker, Kubernetes, Service Meshes) across hyper-scale cloud environments.
- Deep, current experience building with AI and Agentic solutions, including LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, and orchestration patterns, and a track record of deploying AI solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
- Exceptional technical breadth, becoming productive quickly across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, domains, and codebases.
- Deep fluency in modern development practices, including CI/CD, automation, cloud-native architecture, testing, and developer tooling.
- Practical, current command of AI across the software development lifecycle, and the ability to coach engineering teams in adopting it effectively.
- A working grasp of responsible AI, governance, and production monitoring for AI systems.
- A proven ability to parachute into unfamiliar teams, build trust fast, and deliver measurable outcomes under time pressure.
- A pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset that prioritizes shipping, working software and teaching by doing.
- Strong communication and influencing skills that earn credibility with engineers and program leaders alike.
- Comfort with ambiguity, frequent context-switching, and self-directed scoping where you can add the most value.
- Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, or equivalent AI development platform preferred.
- Demonstrated passion for simplification, innovation, and enabling speed and quality across the organization.

title: SME - Paid Search
jobDescription:
Who are we
MarketOne International is a global provider of marketing services helping companies identify new prospects, develop sales lead programs, and convert new business. Our wide array of services includes contact database development, event recruitment, automated marketing, sales lead development, primary market research and Lead Lifecycle Management. MarketOne serves leading technology companies around the globe, including 8 of the 10 largest tech companies in the world.

With delivery capability across Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Americas, MarketOne has fast become the go-to partner for large-scale, global marketing initiatives that rely on sophisticated demand generation programs. Our corporate track record features fifteen consecutive years of growth and profitability.

Job Summary
The Paid Search SME will own the strategy, planning, execution, optimization, and performance of paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), and other relevant search advertising platforms to drive qualified traffic, leads, conversions, revenue, and overall business growth. The ideal candidate will bring proven B2B paid search experience, preferably supporting clients targeting Fortune 5000 companies, enterprise audiences, and key B2B decision-makers, with an understanding of how paid search supports broader B2B demand-generation and Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities
  • Own Paid Search strategy, media planning, forecasting, budgeting, and investment recommendations aligned with business objectives and performance targets.
  • Develop and execute B2B paid search strategies focused on enterprise audiences, high-value accounts, lead generation, pipeline, and revenue growth.
  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, Demand Gen, remarketing/retargeting, and other relevant paid search formats.
  • Manage campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), and other relevant search advertising platforms, including Bing content syndication campaigns.
  • Develop keyword and search strategies through keyword research, match types, competitive analysis, Auction Insights, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management.
  • Develop B2B keyword and audience strategies aligned with industry, company, and account.
  • Develop audience and targeting strategies, including remarketing/retargeting, Customer Match, in-market, affinity, website, and other relevant audience segments.
  • Leverage first-party data, Customer Match and other relevant audience data to support B2B targeting and account-based strategies.
  • Implement, test, and optimize bidding strategies, campaign structures, budgets, and spend allocation to achieve CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion, revenue, and other defined KPIs.
  • Conduct A/B testing of ad copy, landing pages, assets/extensions, keywords, audiences, and other campaign variables to improve performance.
  • Understand emerging search optimization practices such as GEO, AEO, LLMO, and AI Overviews, and assess their impact on paid search strategy, search behavior, and campaign performance.
  • Monitor and analyze key performance metrics including CTR, CPC, conversions, conversion rate, CPA/CPL, ROAS, Quality Score, impression share, and revenue, identifying optimization and scaling opportunities.
  • Provide performance-based budget recommendations, forecasts, and actionable insights to support business and channel growth.
  • Manage campaign tracking and measurement, including UTMs, conversion tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and offline conversion tracking where applicable; troubleshoot tracking and attribution discrepancies.
  • Partner with analytics and data teams to measure B2B lead quality, pipeline contribution, offline conversions, and revenue impact where applicable.
  • Prepare campaign, ad, keyword, audience, and channel-level reports, translating performance data into clear business recommendations.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align Paid Search activity with broader B2B demand-generation, lead-generation, and ABM strategies.
  • Work with teams managing B2B-focused channels to develop an integrated paid media strategy and ensure consistent audience, messaging, and performance objectives across channels.
  • Partner with SEO, content, analytics, creative, and other digital marketing teams to deliver an integrated search strategy.
  • Establish Paid Search best practices, governance, SOPs, testing frameworks, and optimization methodologies; mentor junior team members.
  • Stay current with search advertising platform updates, algorithm changes, automation, new features, advertising policies, and industry trends.

Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Business, Advertising, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5 - 7+ years of hands-on experience in SEM/PPC, Paid Search, or Performance Marketing.
  • Strong expertise in Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), and other relevant search advertising platforms.
  • Proven B2B Paid Search or Performance Marketing experience, preferably supporting clients targeting Fortune 5000 companies, enterprise audiences, or high-value B2B accounts.
  • Proven experience managing large media budgets and optimizing campaigns against CPA, CPL, ROAS, revenue, and conversion KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of B2B audience targeting, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), intent-based targeting, first-party data, and lead-generation strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of keyword strategy, bidding, audience targeting, campaign experimentation, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with B2B-focused paid media channels and an understanding of how they complement paid search strategies is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads Editor and Microsoft Advertising Editor; relevant platform certifications are preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Excel/Google Sheets, and performance reporting; agency experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate performance data into actionable business recommendations.

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Mainframe Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to redefine the reliability, automation, and efficiency of our mission-critical z/OS systems. This role combines deep mainframe expertise with cutting-edge SRE practices, focusing on innovations in observability, AI-driven operations, and DevOps integration to transform legacy workflows into modern, self-healing systems. You will drive initiatives to eliminate manual toil, optimize performance, and ensure the platform s resilience aligns with business-critical service level objectives (SLOs).

Responsibilities

  • SRE-Centric Innovation Automation
    • Automation Engineering: Design and deploy Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Ansible, Zowe CLI, and z/OSMF workflows to automate system provisioning, configuration management, and recovery processes.
    • Develop self-healing workflows for critical subsystems (CICS, Db2, IMS) to auto-resolve incidents like JVM failures or transaction bottlenecks.
    • Convert legacy operational scripts (REXX, NCL) into modern, version-controlled pipelines integrated with Git and CI/CD tools like Jenkins.
  • AI-Driven Observability
    • Implement predictive analytics tools (e.g., IBM Watson AIOps, Splunk ITSI) to detect anomalies in system metrics, logs, and message queues.
    • Build dashboards using Grafana or Prometheus to visualize the Four Golden Signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation) across mainframe workloads.
    • Centralize alert management to reduce noise and prioritize actionable alerts using AI-driven correlation.
  • DevOps Integration Modernization
    • CI/CD for Mainframe:
      • Streamline software delivery pipelines for COBOL/PL/I applications using IBM Dependency-Based Build (DBB) and UrbanCode Deploy (UCD).
      • Integrate mainframe SDLC processes with enterprise Git repositories (GitHub, GitLab) to enable collaborative development and audit trails.
      • Enable automated testing and phased rollouts for z/OS middleware updates.
  • Performance Capacity Engineering
    • Optimize CPU/MIPS utilization through runtime tuning (e.g., CICS Threadsafe, AT-TLS offloading) to reduce software licensing costs.
    • Forecast capacity demands using historical SMF/RMF data and propose dynamic hardware scaling strategies.
    • Conduct load testing for batch and OLTP workloads to validate system limits and error budgets.
  • Incident Management Reliability
    • Lead blameless postmortems for critical incidents, focusing on root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions (e.g., monitoring gaps, automation fixes).
    • Reduce MTTR by implementing automated incident response playbooks (e.g., auto-restart failed subsystems, reroute traffic).
    • Maintain 24/7 operational readiness through on-call rotations and cross-training in z/OS, CICS, Db2, and storage management.
  • Platform Hardening Knowledge Sharing
    • Enforce security best practices (RACF, TLS) and vulnerability remediation for z/OS and middleware.
    • Develop reusable workbooks and runbooks to document system configurations, troubleshooting steps, and automation workflows.
    • Mentor teams on SRE principles, fostering a T-shaped skill model (deep mainframe + DevOps/ Agile practices).
  • Batch Optimization Resource Management
    • Design dynamic resource allocation strategies (e.g., WLM policies, enclaves) to prioritize critical batch jobs and minimize contention for CPU, memory, and I/O resources.
    • Implement parallel processing (e.g., multi-task JCL, SYSAFF routing) to reduce runtime and avoid bottlenecks in long-running batch cycles.
    • Streamline job dependencies using graph-based scheduling tools (e.g., IWS, CA7, Control-M) to eliminate idle wait times between interdependent jobs.
  • Proactive Batch Health Monitoring
    • Develop automated checks for batch job SLAs, including real-time alerts for delays, resource starvation, or dataset contention.
    • Integrate predictive analytics (e.g., historical SMF data analysis) to forecast and mitigate delays caused by seasonal peaks or data volume spikes.

jobDescription:
Position Summary...
What youll do...
About the Team
Walmart s Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of building a future-ready workforce. We are a passionate and strategic team dedicated to identifying, engaging, and hiring exceptional talent that powers our business and serves millions of customers every day.
As part of the Leadership Talent Acquisition team, you will play a critical role in shaping Walmart s technology leadership organization by identifying and attracting exceptional leaders from across the global technology ecosystem. You will work closely with senior executives and technology leaders to build leadership talent strategies, strengthen succession pipelines, and hire high-impact talent across Walmart Global Tech.
This role will have a strong focus on Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior technical leadership roles, requiring deep expertise in executive search, passive talent engagement, market intelligence, talent mapping and strategic stakeholder management.
What You ll Do
Lead Senior Leadership Hiring
  • Own end-to-end recruitment for Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior leadership and critical technology roles across Walmart Global Tech.
  • Partner directly with senior executives, VPs, hiring managers and HR leadership to understand business strategy, organization design, workforce plans and leadership talent requirements.
  • Translate complex business and technology needs into targeted leadership hiring strategies and compelling talent propositions.
  • Lead highly confidential and business-critical searches with a strong focus on quality, speed, candidate experience and organizational fit.
Build Executive Talent Strategies Pipelines
  • Develop proactive talent strategies for critical leadership and future capability needs rather than relying solely on active applicants.
  • Build and maintain deep, diverse and market-mapped leadership talent pools across India and global technology markets.
  • Identify and engage passive leadership talent from leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
  • Develop long-term relationships with senior technology executives and high-caliber technical leaders, including candidates who may not be actively seeking opportunities.
  • Build succession-ready external talent pipelines for strategic and hard-to-fill leadership positions.
Executive Search Talent Mapping
  • Conduct sophisticated research and talent mapping across technology ecosystems to identify relevant leadership talent.
  • Leverage executive search methodologies, market intelligence, professional networks, AI-enabled sourcing tools and industry relationships to identify exceptional talent.
  • Develop talent maps covering leadership capabilities, organizational structures, technology expertise, career progression and relevant market pools.
  • Build targeted competitive intelligence on talent movements, leadership changes, organizational expansions, layoffs, acquisitions and emerging technology hubs.
  • Establish relationships with senior leaders and external talent communities to strengthen Walmart s leadership talent brand.
Strategic Stakeholder Partnership
  • Act as a trusted talent advisor to senior business and technology leaders, providing insights beyond the recruitment process.
  • Challenge hiring assumptions constructively and influence decisions through data, market intelligence and talent availability.
  • Consult with leaders on talent strategy, role calibration, market positioning, compensation considerations and competitive hiring dynamics.
  • Establish clear search strategies, candidate profiles, assessment expectations and decision-making frameworks at the beginning of each search.
  • Facilitate alignment across multiple senior stakeholders and ensure disciplined governance throughout the hiring process.
Candidate Engagement Experience
  • Personally engage and build relationships with senior candidates throughout the hiring journey.
  • Develop compelling, personalized value propositions for leadership candidates based on their career aspirations, technology interests and leadership impact.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to candidates while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism throughout the process.
  • Deliver a differentiated, high-touch "white-glove" candidate experience for senior leadership hires.
  • Effectively manage complex offer discussions, compensation expectations, counteroffers and closing strategies.
Market Intelligence Talent Insights
  • Provide senior leadership with actionable insights on technology talent markets, competitor organizations, leadership movements and compensation trends.
  • Track market availability and competitiveness for critical leadership capabilities.
  • Analyze candidate response, conversion, offer acceptance and hiring trends to continuously improve leadership recruiting strategies.
  • Develop data-driven recommendations to improve Walmarts ability to attract and hire senior technology talent.
  • Build strong understanding of technology domains including AI/ML, Cloud, Data, Software Engineering, Platforms, Infrastructure, Product Engineering and emerging technologies.
Thought Leadership Team Capability
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader for leadership talent acquisition within the organization.
  • Mentor and coach recruiters on advanced sourcing, executive engagement, stakeholder management and closing strategies.
  • Share market intelligence, sourcing strategies, candidate insights and best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Contribute to building scalable leadership hiring frameworks, playbooks and talent intelligence capabilities.
  • Represent Walmart Global Tech externally as a talent ambassador and strengthen relationships with senior technology talent communities.
Governance Operational Excellence
  • Ensure all leadership hiring activities follow Walmarts recruiting processes, compliance requirements and governance standards.
  • Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data within ATS and talent management systems.
  • Establish disciplined search governance, including search strategy, pipeline reviews, interview progress, decision tracking and closure.
  • Use recruitment analytics and funnel metrics to identify opportunities for improving search effectiveness and hiring outcomes.
What You ll Bring
  • 15+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition / Executive Search experience, with significant experience hiring senior technology leadership.
  • Proven experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, VP, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow or equivalent senior technology leadership talent.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, confidential and high-impact leadership searches.
  • Strong understanding of the global technology talent ecosystem and leadership talent markets, particularly across India.
  • Deep expertise in executive sourcing, passive candidate engagement, talent mapping and market intelligence.
  • Strong network among senior technology professionals and leaders across leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
  • Ability to understand complex technology organizations, architectures, products and engineering capabilities and translate them into effective talent strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and hiring leaders using data, market insights and sound talent judgment.
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, relationship-building, negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Experience managing complex stakeholder groups across business, technology, HR, compensation and Talent Acquisition.
  • Strong understanding of executive compensation, competitive talent dynamics and offer negotiation strategies.
  • Proficiency with ATS platforms, talent intelligence tools, LinkedIn and AI-enabled sourcing/recruiting technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert recruiting data and market intelligence into actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage multiple strategic searches and deliver results in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.
  • High degree of confidentiality, integrity, discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive leadership searches.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience recruiting senior technology leaders within large-scale global technology organizations.
  • Experience partnering with C-suite, VP-level stakeholders.
  • Experience building leadership talent pools and succession pipelines proactively.
  • Exposure to hiring across multiple geographies and relocating global technology talent into India.
  • Experience using AI, talent intelligence platforms and data-driven sourcing methodologies to identify and engage executive talent.
  • Experience in building executive talent communities and long-term relationships with senior technology leaders.
What Success Looks Like
In this role, success goes beyond filling open positions. You will be expected to:
  • Build a strong and sustainable pipeline of senior technology leadership talent.
  • Increase Walmarts access to high-caliber passive leadership talent.
  • Deliver exceptional candidates for the most strategically important technology roles.
  • Become a trusted talent advisor to senior technology leadership.
  • Bring actionable external market intelligence into leadership hiring decisions.
  • Strengthen Walmarts ability to attract, engage and close senior technology leaders in a highly competitive market.
  • Build scalable approaches for identifying and engaging future leadership talent before positions become open.
  • Elevate the candidate experience for senior leadership and executive-level hiring.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Manager - Aftersales Operations to own and drive the end-to-end Repair, Replacement, QC, Product Testing and Dispatch Operations across Audio, Wearables and other consumer electronics categories. The role will be responsible for ensuring that products received through customer returns, service centres, warehouses and other channels are accurately received, inspected, tested, repaired/replaced where applicable, dispositioned and dispatched within defined TATs, along with management of spares and inventory through the OMS platform. The individual will work closely with Customer Experience, Warehouse, Inventory, Logistics, Quality, Product, Technology and external service partners to ensure seamless execution of the aftersales lifecycle. This role requires a strong combination of operations management, technical understanding, QC expertise, inventory discipline, data analysis, process improvement and people leadership.
1. End-to-End Repair Replacement Operations
  • Own the complete repair and replacement lifecycle from receipt of returned/defective products to final closure.
  • Define and manage processes for product receiving, physical verification, serial number validation, QC inspection, functional testing, repair assessment, replacement approval, product disposition, inventory reconciliation and final dispatch through CRM.
  • Establish clear SOPs and process controls to minimize leakage, delays, wrong replacements and incorrect dispositions.
  • Ensure replacement products are dispatched within committed customer TAT.
2. Product QC Testing - Audio, Wearables Other Categories
  • Own pre-dispatch and post-return QC/testing for Audio, Wearables and other consumer electronics categories.
  • Define category-wise testing protocols and checklists for TWS/Earbuds, Headphones/Neckbands, Speakers/Audio products, Smartwatches/Smart Bands, Power Banks and other electronic accessories and NPD categories.
  • Ensure complete functional testing before replacement dispatch, refurbishment, restocking, repair closure or customer shipment.
  • Build testing parameters covering battery performance, charging, Bluetooth/pairing, audio output, microphone, touch/buttons, sensors, display, connectivity, app synchronization, physical condition, accessories and packaging.
  • Ensure products failing QC are correctly segregated and do not enter saleable/replacement inventory.
  • Continuously improve testing methodology based on emerging customer complaints and product defect trends.
3. Replacement Product Dispatch Management
  • Own replacement dispatch readiness and ensure only QC-approved products are dispatched.
  • Maintain controls around product model, SKU, serial number, colour/variant, product condition, accessories and packaging.
  • Coordinate with Warehouse and Inventory teams to ensure replacement stock is available and accurately reflected in the system.
  • Establish daily dispatch plans based on ageing and customer commitment.
  • Track pending replacement cases and ensure there are no avoidable ageing cases.
  • Identify bottlenecks causing delays in replacement dispatch and implement corrective actions.
4. TAT Management
  • Own and monitor end-to-end aftersales TAT across receiving, QC, repair, replacement and dispatch.
  • Define stage-wise TATs and SLAs for product receiving, QC inspection, technical testing, repair assessment, replacement approval, inventory allocation and dispatch.
  • Maintain daily ageing dashboards and ensure cases crossing SLA are immediately escalated.
  • Drive a culture of zero avoidable ageing within the team.
  • Identify root causes of TAT breaches and implement preventive measures.
  • Publish daily/weekly TAT performance reports to senior leadership.
  • Key TAT Metrics tracked: Overall Repair TAT, Replacement TAT, QC TAT; Receiving-to-QC TAT, QC-to-Dispatch TAT; Average Ageing, Cases > SLA; First-Time-Right QC %, Dispatch SLA adherence %.
5. Returns Reverse Logistics Management
  • Own the operational strategy for products returning from customers, service centres, marketplaces and other channels.
  • Analyse return volumes and identify major drivers.
  • Ensure returned products are correctly classified into Repairable, Replaceable, NTF/No Trouble Found, Physical Damage, Liquid Damage, Manufacturing Defect, Refurbishable, Scrap/Non-recoverable and Restockable.
  • Ensure proper disposition and system closure of every returned unit.
  • Work with Logistics and Warehouse teams to reduce reverse-logistics TAT and cost.
6. Root Cause Analysis Defect Reduction
  • Analyse product return and QC data to identify recurring product and process failures.
  • Build RCA dashboards covering top complaint reasons, top defective SKUs, product/category-wise failure rates, NTF %, repeat failure %, repair failure %, QC rejection %, replacement rate and return rate.
  • Partner with Product, Quality, Engineering and NPD teams to identify systemic product issues.
  • Convert customer complaint data into actionable product improvement recommendations.
  • Track corrective and preventive actions until closure.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary replacements, repairs and returns.
7. Customer Experience Partnership
  • Work closely with Customer Experience / Customer Service leadership to ensure operational issues do not negatively impact customer experience.
  • Create clear escalation mechanisms between CX and Aftersales Operations.
  • Ensure customer commitments made by CX teams are operationally achievable and tracked.
  • Provide CX teams with accurate visibility on product availability, repair status, replacement status, QC status, dispatch status and expected TAT.
  • Support CX escalations involving delayed repairs, replacement delays, product quality concerns and exceptional cases.
8. Warehouse Inventory Management
  • Partner closely with Warehouse and Inventory teams to maintain 100% stock accuracy for repair and replacement inventory.
  • Ensure proper segregation of fresh stock, replacement stock, returned stock, repairable stock, refurbished stock, QC hold stock, defective stock and scrap stock.
  • Monitor physical vs system inventory reconciliation.
  • Ensure no product is dispatched without appropriate system and QC clearance.
  • Minimize inventory ageing and unidentified inventory.
  • Establish controls for serial-number-level inventory tracking.
9. Team Management Leadership
  • Lead and manage QC Engineers, QC Specialists, Inventory Associates and Aftersales Operations Associates.
  • Define manpower requirements based on business volumes and workload.
  • Hire, train, coach and develop team members.
  • Establish individual and team-level performance KPIs.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and provide structured feedback.
  • Manage daily manpower planning and workload allocation.
  • Ensure adequate staffing during peak periods and product launches.
  • Build technical capability within the QC team through regular training and certification.
  • Establish accountability at individual process stages.
10. Process Excellence Automation
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify and automate aftersales processes.
  • Work with Technology/Product/Engineering teams to improve RMS and internal systems.
  • Drive automation for product receiving, serial number validation, QC status, inventory movement, repair tracking, replacement allocation, dispatch readiness, TAT alerts, ageing alerts and reporting dashboards.
  • Eliminate manual trackers wherever system-based solutions are feasible.
  • Develop robust SOPs, process maps, escalation matrices and control mechanisms.
11. Cost Management
  • Identify opportunities to reduce the cost of repairs, replacements, reverse logistics, packaging, inventory handling, manpower, refurbishment and scrap.
  • Monitor cost per return, cost per repair and cost per replacement.
  • Reduce unnecessary replacements through better diagnosis and testing.
  • Improve recovery from returned products through refurbishment/restocking wherever commercially and operationally viable.
  • Track savings generated through process improvement initiatives.
12. Escalation Exception Management
  • Own critical operational escalations related to delayed replacements, delayed repairs, QC disputes, wrong product dispatch, inventory mismatch, repeated product failures, customer escalations and partner/service-centre disputes.
  • Establish an escalation matrix with clear ownership and resolution timelines.
  • Ensure high-priority cases receive immediate action and do not age unnecessarily.
  • Work with CX leadership on customer-sensitive cases requiring exceptional intervention.
13. MIS, Analytics Senior Management Reporting
  • Daily dashboards covering: products received, products under QC, QC completed; repair pending, replacement pending, dispatch pending; cases ageing beyond SLA, inventory availability and QC rejection rate.
  • Weekly/Monthly dashboards covering: return rate, replacement rate, repair rate, NTF %; QC pass %, QC rejection %, restock rate, refurbishment recovery %; average TAT, SLA adherence; cost per return, cost per repair, cost per replacement; product/category-wise defect trends, top RCA drivers and team productivity.
  • Present actionable insights to senior management rather than only reporting numbers - highlighting key risks, gaps, corrective actions and expected business impact.
The Ideal Noisemaker
  • 10-12+ years of relevant experience in Aftersales, Repair Operations, QC, Returns, Reverse Logistics, Warehouse Operations or Consumer Electronics.
  • Experience managing Audio, Wearables, Mobile Accessories or consumer electronics preferred.
  • Experience managing QC/testing teams and warehouse/inventory operations.
  • Strong experience in Repair Replacement / RMA / Returns Management.
  • Experience working with RMS/WMS or other inventory and aftersales systems.
  • Strong understanding of consumer electronics QC and testing, and the ability to define QC protocols and testing checklists.

  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills, with experience creating operational dashboards and MIS.
  • Strong people-management, team-building and stakeholder-management skills - able to work with CX, Warehouse, Logistics, Product, Quality and Technology teams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
Key Performance Indicators
  • Replacement TAT Repair TAT - maintain agreed SLA.
  • QC TAT - same-day / defined SLA adherence.
  • Dispatch TAT - timely dispatch of QC-approved units.
  • SLA Adherence - maximize; Ageing Cases - minimize.
  • QC Accuracy First-Time-Right QC - maximize.

  • Cost per Return / Cost per Repair - reduce and optimize.

jobDescription:

And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY GDS | PEOPLE CONSULTING | LEARNING CHANGE
Staff Consultant, Learning Change
Build consulting craft. Create with AI. Connect across languages.
ROLE SNAPSHOT
Role
Staff Consultant, Learning Change
Portfolio
Learning Development, People Consulting MENA

Experience
2-4 years of relevant professional experience
Capability model
Learning consulting with organisational change capability and AI-enabled ways of working

THE OPPORTUNITY
This role is an entry point into a consulting career in Learning and Change within EY GDS People Consulting. You will contribute to live MENA client work, strategic proposals and capability-building initiatives across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.
You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. The role blends learning design, change enablement, digital learning, project coordination and responsible use of AI. It is not a learning administration-only position.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Learning design and capability development
  • Support learning needs analysis, learner personas, skills-gap reviews and role-to-capability mapping
  • Help design learning journeys, curriculum maps, course outlines and blended learning experiences across ILT, VILT, WBT, microlearning and performance support.
  • Develop e-learning modules, storyboards, facilitator and learner guides, job aids, simulations, quick-reference guides, assessments and reinforcement assets.
  • Use adult learning principles and instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM, under guidance from senior team members.
  • Support learning evaluation, feedback analysis, knowledge assessment and outcome reporting.
Organisational change and adoption support
  • Maintain stakeholder registers, change-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
  • Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
  • Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion-network materials for review.
  • Assist with readiness, adoption and reinforcement activities that connect learning to business change outcomes.
Pursuits, proposals and market support
  • Conduct structured client, sector, benchmark and competitor research for RFPs, RFQs and proactive proposals.
  • Draft proposal content, credentials, CVs, case studies, methodology slides, workplan inputs and capability-showcase materials.
  • Create clear, consulting-quality PowerPoint materials and maintain version control under tight deadlines.
  • Review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
  • Help maintain the capability, proposal and case-study repositories.
Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations
  • Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
  • Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
  • Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
  • Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post-course sustainment where included in project scope.
  • Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject-matter experts and internal teams.
AI-enabled learning and digital content
  • Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
  • Apply human review, fact-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI-assisted outputs.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.
  • Create or edit digital learning assets using tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, Captivate, Vyond, Camtasia, Synthesia, Clipchamp or comparable platforms.
  • Support content upload, testing and reporting on platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, Docebo, SharePoint or similar environments.
SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS
  • Consulting potential: Structures information clearly, asks good questions and connects deliverables to the client need.
  • Written and visual communication: Produces concise English and well-structured presentations with strong attention to detail.
  • AI fluency: Uses AI productively and responsibly rather than treating generated output as final.
  • Design sensibility: Understands learning experience, usability, visual hierarchy and audience needs.
  • Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.
  • Organisation: Manages several tasks, deadlines and versions without losing quality.
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
Essentia
  • 1-3 years of relevant experience in learning design, LD, content development, training delivery, change support, HR or organisational development, consulting or a related area.
  • Bachelor s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
  • Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
  • Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.
  • Practical use of Microsoft Copilot or comparable generative AI tools for research, synthesis or content creation, with evidence of responsible review.
  • Demonstrated business-level proficiency to review proposal content, take part in stakeholder discussions and support workshops.
  • Excellent spoken and written English and willingness to support MENA working hours.
Preferred
  • Experience in a consulting, professional-services, GCC-facing or shared-services environment.
  • Exposure to organisational change frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one digital learning authoring or media tool.
  • Exposure to LMS, LXP, digital adoption platforms, learning analytics or Power BI.
  • Experience supporting proposals, market research, credentials or business-development materials.
  • Exposure to government, energy or financial-services contexts.
CERTIFICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT
Required at joining or within the agreed development plan Preferred / differentiating
  • Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI fundamentals
  • Design thinking / human-centred design foundation
  • Instructional design or adult learning foundation
  • Change management foundation or agreed pathway
  • PROSCI foundation or equivalent
  • APTD or similar learning credential
  • Agile fundamentals
  • Articulate, learning platform or learning analytics credential
WAYS OF WORKING
Initial ramp-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.
KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS
Dimension
Delivery
Support at least one significant learning or change workstream; deliver assigned outputs at first or second review with limited rework. Workplan, review records and engagement feedback.
Pursuits
Support at least 5 strategic pursuits and contribute substantive content to at least 3 proposal submissions, subject to pipeline volume. Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
AI adoption
Demonstrate responsible AI-assisted working in research, proposals or content; contribute to one AI-enabled learning use case or accelerator. Approved work samples, demo or use-case record.
Capability assets
Create or materially improve at least 2 reusable assets, templates, credentials or case studies. Repository and reuse log.
Digital learning
Demonstrate working competence in at least one authoring or media tool and exposure to one learning platform or analytics tool. Skills assessment or project evidence.
Growth
Complete agreed learning, change and AI development milestones and show progress toward Consultant readiness. Development plan and certification record.
Utilisation
Meet the approved grade utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with targets calibrated to actual staffing. Utilisation and resource reports.

  • Exposure to live MENA learning, change, digital adoption and workforce capability programmes.
  • A structured pathway across learning consulting, organisational change, AI-enabled learning and consulting craft.
  • Hands-on experience with modern authoring tools, learning platforms, analytics and approved AI tools.
  • Coaching from experienced consultants and the opportunity to shape a growing portfolio.
  • A career path from Staff Consultant to broader workstream and solution ownership.

title: Supervisor - Document Intelligence
jobDescription:
ABOUT THIS ROLE
GHX is standing up a new Human-in-the-Loop (HiTL) operations team in Hyderabad to support its ADM (Automated Document Management) platform - an AI-powered document processing system replacing legacy UiPath automation for GFax North America. The platform processes over 2.2 million Purchase Orders per year and targets a 75-85% fully-automated (touchless) rate. The team handles every document the AI cannot process autonomously.
The Operations Supervisor is building this team from zero and is accountable for everything within it: throughput, field accuracy, team development, day-to-day operations management, and real-time coordination with GHX Engineering and Product teams in the United States. This is a high-visibility, inaugural role - the team s accuracy and throughput directly determine the speed and confidence with which GHX can expand the ADM platform beyond GFax North America.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
People Performance Management - 70%
  • Directly supervise 15-20 Document Review Specialists; own rostering across rotational shifts, attendance tracking, and queue capacity planning against daily document volume
  • Manage operations SLA - TAT, Quality, along with people metrics
  • Own day-to-day operations management: shift rosters and week-offs, leave planning, planned unplanned shrinkage, absenteeism control, and real-time reallocation of staffing to protect SLAs operations performance metrics
  • Set and communicate daily, weekly, and monthly throughput, AHT, and accuracy targets; monitor individual and team performance against SLA and productivity standards
  • Participate in and present at weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (WBR / MBR / QBR) - performance against KPIs, root-cause analysis of misses, and committed corrective actions
  • Own the full performance cycle for direct reports, including goal setting, mid-year and annual appraisals, with documented performance ratings, development plans, and calibration against peer supervisors
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s and team calibration sessions; coach on accuracy, field interpretation, and escalation judgment
  • Manage performance improvement plans for specialists not meeting accuracy, AHT, or throughput standards; drive engagement and retention to control attrition
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members; maintain a bench and cross-skilling plan to cover leave and attrition
