title: Identity Access Management Operations and Engineering Manager
jobDescription:
Identity Access Management Operations and Engineering Manager
Job Locations IN-Bangalore
Requisition ID 2026-16534
Category (Portal Searching) Information Technology
Position Type (Portal Searching) Experienced Professional
Overview
Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity.

With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
Business Segment Overview
Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
Position Purpose: As Identity Access Management Operations and Engineering Manager for IT Risk and Security, you will lead an IAM Operations and Identity Engineering function within StoneX, owning both the day-to-day identity service the firm depends on and the engineering of the platforms that deliver it. The estate runs core identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID with Active Directory, and Okta. Around them sit enterprise PKI, privileged access management, modern authentication and identity governance tooling, alongside legacy platforms now being retired. The ideal candidate will have experience working in a regulated financial environment and is a highly skilled, experienced and motivated leader willing to drive and grow our identity function across a globally distributed team.
Responsibilities
Primary duties will include:
  • Own the identity service catalogue end to end - joiner, mover and leaver processing, access request, entitlement and group administration, privileged account issuance, certificate services and application onboarding and the service levels each commitment carries.
  • Set the engineering and operations roadmap and act as technical design authority across both core identity platforms; Entra ID with hybrid directory services and Okta as well as identity governance and administration, privileged access management, PKI and certificate lifecycle, federation and single sign-on, and modern authentication.
  • Run the operational disciplines behind the service: incident and problem management for identity outages, change control, capacity and availability planning, and a documented escalation and on-call model that holds across time zones.
  • Design, implement and maintain IAM policies, procedures and standards to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of sensitive data and resources.
  • Manage and lead a team (1-3) of identity engineers and analysts and building coverage so that every platform has more than one engineer, in more than one region, who can safely operate it.
  • Drive standing privilege down across the estate: run the access certification and recertification cycle, enforce segregation of duties and least privilege, eliminate orphaned and dormant accounts, and bring service, workload and other non-human identities under the same lifecycle discipline as people.
  • Act as identity manager you will be working with the team and supporting internal audit, external audit and client or scheme assessments including SWIFT CSP, inc. producing evidence on request, owning remediation actions and closing findings to agreed dates.
  • Automate the routine work out of the service: provisioning and deprovisioning driven from authoritative HR sources, policy and role-based entitlement in place of ticket-by-ticket approval and reporting instrumented so identity risk is visible without a manual data pull.
  • Own identity data quality and metrics, account ownership, lifecycle state, entitlement mapping and application registration as the foundation every downstream control, report and detection depends on.
  • Lead directory and tenant consolidation and legacy platform decommissioning, including the absorption of acquired identity estates onto the strategic Entra ID and Okta platforms, working directly with the application teams that depend on those platforms rather than routing every migration through the identity team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams - security architecture, security operations, enterprise IT, HR, compliance and the business to assess IAM requirements and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Manage external partners and vendors against their commitments, and contribute to forecasting and planning for identity licensing, tooling and headcount.
  • Maintain IAM process documentation, including end-user guidance, runbooks and team processes and procedures, to a standard that allows work to move between regions without loss.
Qualifications
To land this role you will need:
  • This individual must be capable of working with internal and customer-facing teams to facilitate process improvement and customer support resulting in an enhanced security posture, reduction in risk and improvement in end-user experience. Excellent communication, strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential.
  • 10+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 6 years in identity and access management and 3+ years leading and directly managing an IAM team, with accountability for both a production service and an engineering backlog; experience in financial services a plus.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing and managing complex IAM processes and solutions within large organizations.
  • Deep, current, hands-on knowledge of both core platforms. Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory in a hybrid estate - tenant and forest design, synchronisation, conditional access, privileged role management and entitlement models. Okta - policy architecture, authentication journeys, application integration, lifecycle management and federation at scale.
  • Production delivery experience across at least three of: identity governance and administration tooling, privileged access management such as CyberArk, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, federation and single sign-on, and multi-factor or passwordless authentication.
  • Knowledge and implementation of key security concepts such as RBAC, zero trust, identity lifecycle automation, least privilege and identity governance, together with command of the underlying protocols SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, Kerberos and LDAP.
  • Automation and scripting ability sufficient to lead engineers credibly e.g. PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and the Okta management APIs with practical use of source control, pipelines and configuration-as-code applied to identity change.
  • Demonstrated operational management discipline: service level definition and reporting, incident, problem and change management, and oversight of vendors or managed service providers.
  • Direct experience owning identity controls through audit - preparing evidence, defending design decisions to auditors or regulators, and closing findings.
  • Understanding of a broad range of general information security domains, including networking, cybersecurity, governance and risk, and cloud.
  • Strong leadership skills with a track record of successfully leading distributed and cross-functional teams across time zones, including offshore or GCC-based staff.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
What makes you stand out:
  • You have an operations mindset and an engineers instinct; you see an inefficient process and immediately think of how to automate it away rather than staff it.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are comfortable juggling a live service and a delivery roadmap at the same time.
  • You are equally comfortable in both platforms and can reason about where a capability belongs - Entra ID or Okta - rather than defaulting to the one you know best.
  • You build people as deliberately as you build platforms, and you measure your team by the cover and capability it has, not by the hours it works.
  • You have experience in a Zero Trust program, or with securing non-human identities including service accounts, workload identities and emerging agentic and AI workloads.
Education / Certification Requirements:
  • Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, information security or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) preferred.
  • Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator preferred.
  • CISSP, CISM, CyberArk Defender or Sentry, or an equivalent identity governance credential preferred; ITIL foundation or equivalent service management training is a plus.
Working environment:
  • 4 days work from office
  • Working hours aligned to India business hours, with overlap into CET / BST.
  • Team distributed across UK, US and Latam locations; participation in an escalation and on-call rotation should be expected.
  • Travel requirements, for leadership meetings and conferences.

title: Campaign Manager - AI Operations
jobDescription:
About Us:

Paytm is Indias leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:

The AI Operations team is responsible for building, launching, and scaling AI-powered voice and Agentic AI solutions across Paytm s merchant ecosystem.

The team works closely with Business, Product, Technology, Data, QA, and Operations teams to drive AI-led automation across merchant engagement, retention, activation, support, and service journeys.

The team owns the complete operational lifecycle of AI campaigns - from use-case identification and conversational journey design to voice-bot creation, prompt development, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, and continuous optimization .

About the role:

We are looking for a Campaign Manager - AI Operations who will own the end-to-end execution and success of AI-powered voice and Agentic AI campaigns.

The role will involve creating AI voice agents, writing and optimizing prompts, designing conversational journeys, launching campaigns, monitoring performance, analyzing AI interactions, and continuously improving the agent to drive measurable business outcomes.

The candidate should have a strong combination of operations understanding, prompt engineering, conversational AI, analytical thinking, and execution skills .

Role Expectations/ Responsibilities:

AI Agent Creation: Build and configure AI voice agents for different merchant use cases by defining conversation journeys, agent behavior, business rules, objection handling, and closure logic.
Prompt Engineering: Write, test, and continuously optimize production-ready prompts to ensure the AI agent follows the required conversation flow, understands merchant responses, asks relevant questions, handles objections, and drives the intended outcome.
Conversational Journey Design: Translate business requirements and operational processes into structured AI conversations covering opening, intent identification, probing, resolution, objection handling, confirmation, and closure.
Campaign Ownership: Own AI campaigns end-to-end, from understanding the business requirement and creating the AI agent to testing, launch, monitoring, and post-live optimization.
Campaign Performance: Track and analyze campaign KPIs such as connect rate, successful outcome, retention, activation, conversion, AHT, FCR, drop-offs, retry effectiveness, and cost per successful outcome.
AI Call Analysis: Review AI call recordings and transcripts to identify issues such as incorrect responses, repetition, hallucination, unnecessary probing, long monologues, missed objections, incorrect intent identification, and poor call closure.
Prompt Agent Optimization: Convert call-level observations into actionable improvements in prompts, agent instructions, conversation flows, business logic, and tool usage.
Agentic AI Optimization: Work on improving the agents ability to understand context, make appropriate decisions, use available tools, follow business rules, and complete the intended merchant journey autonomously.
Quality Management: Partner with QA teams to define AI quality parameters, conduct regular audits, identify critical quality/compliance gaps, and implement corrective actions.
Business Outcome Management: Ensure AI campaigns are optimized for measurable business outcomes and not only operational metrics such as call connectivity.
A/B Testing Experimentation: Design and execute experiments across prompts, conversation flows, scripts, retry strategies, and campaign configurations to improve campaign performance.
Production Monitoring: Closely monitor newly launched campaigns, identify issues early, and drive corrective actions to stabilize and scale campaigns.
Data Analytics: Analyze campaign dashboards, call-level data, MIS, and AI performance trends to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, QA, Business, and Operations teams to develop, launch, troubleshoot, and scale AI campaigns.
AI Platform Coordination: Coordinate with the internal Agentic AI/Product/Technology teams for platform enhancements, integrations, tool/API requirements, defects, and new capabilities required for campaigns.
Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate campaign setup, reporting, ticket updates, retries, outcome capture, and other operational processes.
Cost Optimization: Monitor AI calling efficiency and optimize call duration, retry strategy, conversation flow, and campaign configuration to improve cost per successful outcome.
Documentation Governance: Maintain campaign documentation including prompts, conversation flows, business rules, test cases, success metrics, changes, and deployment requirements.

Key Success Metrics:

The role will be measured across AI quality, campaign performance, business outcomes, and operational efficiency , including:

AI campaign connect rateSuccessful outcome / conversion rate
Merchant retention and activation AI conversation quality score
AHT and call efficiency FCR / successful resolution
Prompt and AI agent performance improvement
Reduction in hallucinations and critical compliance issues
Retry effectiveness
Cost per successful outcome
Campaign launch timelines
Automation and manual effort reduction

Experience: 1-1.5 years of experience in Operations, Campaign Management, Contact Centre Operations, Conversational AI, Voice Automation, or a related domain. (Freshers can also apply).
AI/ Voice Experience: Hands-on experience with AI voice bots, Agentic AI, conversational AI, IVR, voice automation, or contact-center automation.
Prompt Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in writing and optimizing prompts for AI/LLM-based applications, preferably voice-based systems.
Operations Understanding: Strong understanding of contact-center operations, customer/merchant journeys, campaign management, and operational KPIs.
Conversation Design: Ability to convert complex business requirements into simple, structured, and effective AI conversations.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. SQL and BI tools will be an advantage.
AI Quality: Ability to analyze AI conversations and identify issues related to intent understanding, prompt adherence, hallucination, repetition, tone, compliance, and outcome achievement.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to work with Product, Engineering, Data, QA, Business, and Operations teams to drive AI initiatives.
Execution: Strong ownership and ability to manage multiple AI campaigns simultaneously from requirement gathering through production and optimization.

title: Staff Systems Administrator
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Shield AI is seeking a highly autonomous Staff Systems Administrator to serve as the accountable technical owner for enterprise IT infrastructure and end-user computing within a dedicated, security-sensitive entity environment. This senior individual contributor will design, implement, operate, secure, and continuously improve on-premises systems, cloud platforms, identity services, networks, and endpoints while preserving required legal, operational, information-security, and access boundaries.

The role combines deep infrastructure ownership with hands-on service delivery. The successful candidate will translate security and compliance requirements into durable technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, drive equipment and endpoint hardening, and deliver resilient support to engineering and business teams with minimal oversight.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Ownership (On-Prem Cloud)

  • Own and operate on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup platforms, identity services, core network services, and enterprise applications.
  • Administer Azure and/or AWS environments with responsibility for availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, secure configuration, backup, and disaster-recovery readiness.
  • Define technical roadmaps, identify operational risks, and independently drive modernization, standardization, scalability, and resilience improvements.
  • Maintain accurate architecture diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, recovery documentation, configuration records, and service ownership information.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure changes using disciplined change, testing, rollback, and post-implementation review practices.

Firewalled Entity and Segmented-Environment Support

  • Operate technology services for a dedicated legal or operating entity with explicit separation of systems, identities, data, administration, suppliers, and access from other corporate environments where required.
  • Implement and maintain approved trust boundaries, network segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote access, administrative tiers, and controlled cross-entity connectivity.
  • Ensure data, devices, accounts, cloud resources, and third-party access remain within authorized entity, contractual, regulatory, and data-residency boundaries.
  • Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and corporate IT teams to translate entity-specific obligations into practical controls, operating procedures, and evidence.
  • Document and periodically validate boundary controls, data flows, privileged access paths, exceptions, and intercompany dependencies; escalate gaps and drive remediation to closure.
  • Support local business continuity and operational autonomy while aligning with approved global architecture, security standards, and governance.

Security, Compliance, and Systems

  • Establish, implement, and maintain secure configuration baselines for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, network devices, cloud services, and endpoint-management platforms using recognized frameworks and vendor guidance.
  • Own patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows, including asset coverage, risk-based prioritization, remediation timelines, exception documentation, validation, and status reporting.
  • Administer and validate endpoint protections such as full-disk encryption, EDR/XDR, host firewall, secure boot, application controls, device compliance, removable-media controls, and least-privilege configurations.
  • Harden identity and administrative access through role-based access control, multifactor authentication, privileged-access separation, conditional access, service-account governance, and periodic access reviews.
  • Maintain logging, alerting, time synchronization, configuration monitoring, backup protection, and security telemetry needed for detection, investigation, and auditability.
  • Collect and maintain audit-ready evidence; support internal and external audits, control assessments, security reviews, customer requirements, and remediation plans.
  • Participate in incident response, containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for infrastructure and endpoint security events.
  • Manage technical risks and policy exceptions transparently, including compensating controls, accountable owners, expiration dates, and closure plans.

Identity, Endpoint, and Service Delivery

  • Manage Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints through Intune, Jamf, or equivalent tooling, ensuring secure provisioning, configuration compliance, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and timely retirement.
  • Administer Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms, including user and group lifecycle, authentication, authorization, federation, and policy enforcement.
  • Lead onboarding and offboarding activities, including device provisioning, access configuration, license assignment, asset recovery, and compliance validation.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for employees, engineering systems, lab environments, collaboration services, and secure connectivity.
  • Own IT asset lifecycle, software licensing, vendor coordination, procurement support, warranty management, and secure equipment disposal.
  • Use scripting and automation to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and provide meaningful operational and compliance reporting.
  • Contribute reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, and documentation that can scale across comparable international entity environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, enterprise IT operations, or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated success independently owning production IT infrastructure and end-user environments in a complex, regulated, segmented, or security-sensitive organization.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Windows, macOS, and Linux; server administration and virtualization; Azure and/or AWS; and Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms.
  • Practical experience implementing system and endpoint hardening, configuration baselines, patch management, vulnerability remediation, encryption, endpoint detection and response, and least-privilege controls.
  • Experience supporting security or compliance programs and producing evidence for audits, assessments, or customer and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, network segmentation, firewall policy, and secure remote access.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or equivalent, including compliance policy and device lifecycle management.
  • Experience implementing and testing monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities.
  • Excellent documentation, prioritization, risk communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive outcomes under limited supervision.
  • Ability to support time-sensitive operational needs and participate in planned after-hours maintenance or incident response when required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a firewalled, ring-fenced, subsidiary, joint-venture, sovereign, or otherwise separately governed entity environment.
  • Experience supporting engineering, R&D, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other mission-critical technical teams.
  • Working knowledge of recognized security and compliance frameworks such as CIS Controls and Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, or equivalent local and contractual standards.
  • Experience with security tooling such as SIEM, vulnerability-management platforms, privileged-access management, data-loss prevention, certificate management, or network-access control.
  • Experience supporting isolated, air-gapped, export-controlled, or data-residency-restricted systems.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, infrastructure as code, or configuration-management tooling.
  • Familiarity with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD environments, and secure engineering workflows.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, AWS, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA Security+

jobDescription:
Manager - Learning & Development (Content & Digital Learning)

Location: India
Department: Learning & Development / Talent Development
Reports To: Head - Learning & Development

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Manager - Learning & Development to lead the design, development, and implementation of high-impact learning solutions across business operations. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in training content creation within the BPO industry, instructional design, digital learning technologies, and learner experience design.

This role requires a strategic learning professional who can manage end-to-end learning projects, lead a team of content developers and instructional designers, and deliver engaging learning experiences through e-learning modules, AI-enabled learning solutions, digital simulations, gamification, and immersive learning technologies.

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of adult learning principles, business process training, and modern learning technologies, including Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, AI-driven authoring tools, and simulation-based learning platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Strategy & Content Development

  • Design and implement scalable learning solutions aligned with business objectives and operational requirements.
  • Lead the development of training curricula, facilitator guides, learner manuals, assessments, job aids, SOP-based learning content, and knowledge management resources.
  • Create engaging and performance-focused learning experiences for customer service, sales, technical support, and back-office operations within a BPO environment.
  • Apply instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, SAM, Design Thinking, and Learning Experience Design (LxD).
  • Ensure all learning content meets quality, compliance, and organizational standards.

E-Learning & Digital Learning Solutions

  • Develop interactive e-learning programs using Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, and Adobe Captivate.
  • Design and implement simulation-based learning experiences to enhance learner engagement and skill application.
  • Leverage AI-powered authoring tools and automation technologies to improve content development efficiency.
  • Create scenario-based learning, branching simulations, gamified learning journeys, and interactive assessments.
  • Drive adoption of innovative digital learning approaches, including virtual learning environments and immersive technologies.

AI & Digital Simulation Innovation

  • Lead initiatives involving Artificial Intelligence, digital simulations, virtual role-plays, and experiential learning solutions.
  • Integrate AI-enabled learning tools for content creation, personalization, performance support, and learner analytics.
  • Develop customer interaction simulations and process-based learning experiences that reflect real-world business scenarios.
  • Evaluate emerging learning technologies and recommend solutions that improve learning effectiveness and business impact.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach, and mentor instructional designers, content developers, and learning specialists.
  • Establish governance frameworks, content standards, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive continuous capability-building initiatives focused on modern instructional design practices and digital learning innovation.
  • Promote a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Project Management

  • Manage multiple learning projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Partner with Operations, Quality, Training, SMEs, and Business Leaders to identify learning needs and performance gaps.
  • Communicate project progress effectively and manage stakeholder expectations across multiple business functions.
  • Ensure optimal resource allocation and project prioritization.

Learning Analytics & Effectiveness

  • Define and track learning metrics, including learner engagement, completion rates, knowledge retention, and performance improvement.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness using Kirkpatrick's Evaluation Model and other measurement frameworks.
  • Utilize learning analytics to drive continuous improvement and demonstrate business impact.
  • Establish KPIs related to learner performance, operational efficiency, and training quality.

Qualifications & Experience

Experience

  • 8-12 years of experience in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, or Learning Experience Design.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of people management experience.
  • Strong experience in BPO, Customer Experience, Shared Services, Contact Center, or Global Operations environments.
  • Proven experience in content development, curriculum design, and digital learning implementation.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Education, Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Certification in Instructional Design, Digital Learning, Learning Technologies, or Project Management is preferred.

Core Skills & Competencies

Content Creation & Instructional Design

  • Expertise in instructional design and adult learning principles.
  • Strong content writing, editing, and curriculum development capabilities.
  • Experience developing SOP-based, process training, behavioral, and functional learning content.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes into learner-friendly formats.

Learning Technologies

  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Articulate Storyline 360
    • Rise 360
    • Adobe Captivate
    • Learning Management Systems (LMS)
    • AI-enabled learning platforms
    • Simulation and gamification tools

AI & Digital Learning

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered content creation and learning technologies.
  • Knowledge of digital simulations, virtual role-plays, and immersive learning experiences.
  • Exposure to conversational AI, adaptive learning, and learner analytics platforms.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Strong people leadership and coaching skills.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment.
  • Excellent collaboration and relationship management capabilities.
  • Strong project planning, execution, and governance skills.

Communication

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong business writing and technical documentation expertise.
  • Ability to present learning strategies and outcomes to leadership audiences.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Delivery of high-quality learning content and scalable digital learning solutions.
  • Increased adoption of AI-driven learning methodologies and simulation-based training.
  • Improved learner engagement, proficiency, and operational performance.
  • Effective utilization of Articulate, Captivate, and digital learning technologies to drive business outcomes.
  • Strong team performance, innovation, and capability development.
  • Measurable impact on productivity, quality, customer experience, and operational KPIs.

Preferred Attributes

  • Exposure to digital transformation and workforce upskilling initiatives.
  • Passion for learning innovation, AI technologies, and learner experience design.
  • Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking abilities.

jobDescription:
Senior Staff Engineer AI & Agentic Engineering


Location: India (Flexible — WFO preferred, otherwise 2 quarterly visits are compulsory)


The Role

As Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be one of the senior-most individual contributors driving that shift from the engineering side — turning "we should use AI here" into working, production systems. This is not a role where the product hands you a spec. You'll often be the one deciding what's worth building before anyone else has framed the problem.


Your core mandate is threefold:

  1. Build agentic capability into the core platform. Design and ship AI/agent-driven features — autonomous workflows, decision engines, LLM-integrated tooling — into a commerce platform already processing billions in transaction volume.
  2. Operate at the edge of ambiguity. Take a rough direction, not a groomed backlog, and turn it into a scoped, shippable plan yourself. You'll be trusted to define the "what" as much as the "how."
  3. Set the technical bar for how we build with AI. You won't be the only engineer touching this space — you'll help shape the standard others follow.

What You'll Walk Into

  • An agentic initiative already underway — early proof-of-concept work has shipped, momentum exists, but there's no dedicated senior technical owner driving it end-to-end yet
  • A production platform with deep integrations across QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and more — technically complex and high-stakes
  • Owning distinct areas of the platform — you'll have real IC peers at your level, not just reports
  • A manager who will be a technical thought partner, not a filter — you'll engage directly with architecture and roadmap decisions, not through a PM layer

What You'll Do

Agentic Product Development

  • Design and build AI/agent-driven features across the commerce platform — from proof-of-concept to production
  • Own ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems end-to-end without waiting on a fully-groomed spec

Technical Ownership & Craft

  • Make and defend architecture calls independently; bring options with tradeoffs, not open-ended questions
  • Partner with our architecture function on how agentic systems integrate cleanly into the existing platform layer, rather than bypassing it

Roadmap & Direction

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on what to build, not just receive requirements — shape the roadmap, don't just consume it
  • Identify where AI creates real leverage for customers (vs. where it's just a buzzword) and make the case for it

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Set technical direction for others working in the agentic space; raise the bar on how the team builds with AI
  • Communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 8+ years in backend/systems engineering, with real production experience owning complex systems end-to-end
  • Hands-on fluency with AI/LLM tooling — you've built with agents, RAG, tool-calling, or similar, not just used ChatGPT
  • Demonstrated comfort operating without a fully-defined spec — a track record of shaping a fuzzy problem into a concrete, shippable plan
  • Strong, independent architectural judgment — comfortable defending a design decision under scrutiny
  • Self-directed — you don't need a product manager to break down the work before you can start
  • Clear communicator — can explain a technical decision and its tradeoffs to both engineers and leadership

Strong advantages:

  • Experience with .NET / C# (our core stack)
  • Prior experience in a startup or small-team environment where you owned ambiguity by necessity, not choice
  • Exposure to e-commerce, ERP, or integration-heavy platforms

Why Join Webgility

  • Real impact: Your work directly shapes how thousands of small businesses operate, not just how data moves between systems
  • Builder's role: You're defining Webgility's agentic capability, not maintaining an established roadmap someone else set
  • Domain depth: Ecommerce + accounting is a complex, high-stakes integration problem with a large TAM
  • Direct access: You'll work closely with engineering leadership on architecture and direction, with real influence over what gets built next

Webgility is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead large-scale, complex IT services programs spanning cloud, data, platform, and enterprise application landscapes. Program Leadership Delivery

  • Own technical roadmap alignment - ensuring program plans reflect realistic engineering constraints (CI/CD maturity, environment readiness, tech debt, dependency mapping across microservices/platforms).
  • Drive quality engineering practices across programs - test automation coverage, release readiness gates, defect leakage, and production stability metrics.
  • Guide build-vs-buy and platform modernization decisions (e.g., cloud migration, data platform re-architecture) in collaboration with technical leadership.
  • Champion DevOps and SDLC maturity - CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation), observability, and automated deployment practices across program teams.
  • Maintain working fluency in the technology stacks in play (cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, data platforms like Snowflake/Databricks, integration/API layers) sufficient to challenge estimates, de-risk technical dependencies, and speak credibly with client engineering teams.
Strategic Portfolio Management
  • Drive strategic planning and portfolio prioritization, aligning programs with organizational goals and client transformation roadmaps.

  • Shape enterprise-scale program governance structures, risk management frameworks, and escalation mechanisms.
Financial Commercial Governance
  • Own financial governance across program budgeting, forecasting, revenue assurance, and margin optimization.
  • Oversee contract execution, including SOW compliance, change management, commercial negotiations, and cross-vendor dependencies.
Stakeholder Client Management
  • Own client communication at executive and steering committee levels - proactively managing expectations, risks, and escalations.
  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with client and internal leadership, serving as the primary point of accountability for program health.
Generative AI Innovation
  • Define and drive enterprise adoption of Generative AI for program governance, predictive risk analysis, intelligent status reporting, and data-driven decision-making across delivery portfolios.
  • Evaluate and pilot AI-assisted engineering tools (code generation, automated testing, agentic workflows) to improve delivery velocity and quality across programs.
  • Establish responsible AI usage standards within program management practices and mentor delivery teams on effective, scaled adoption.
Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and develop cross-functional and matrixed delivery teams, fostering a high-performance, accountable delivery culture.
  • Build organizational capability by coaching program and project managers on governance best practices, technical literacy, and stakeholder management.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
  • AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
  • Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
  • Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
  • First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
  • High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
  • Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

Connect directly with HR at isha.patnaik@dbmi.edu.in if you believe you are a strong fit.


PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE


Candidates with hands-on experience building B2C or consumer-facing mobile applications will be given strong preference.

Job Description

Job Title

AI/ML Architect Agentic AI, PyTorch & Data Science

Experience

12 16 Years

Location

Chennai (Hybrid)

Employment Type

Full-Time

Shift

Day Shift

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced AI/ML Architect with deep expertise in PyTorch, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI to design and deliver enterprise-scale intelligent solutions. The ideal candidate will lead the end-to-end architecture of AI and ML platforms, enabling predictive, generative, and autonomous AI capabilities that drive business transformation.

The role involves defining scalable AI architectures, implementing machine learning best practices, designing agentic AI systems, and guiding teams in building production-ready AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.

Mandatory Skills

  • PyTorch
  • Data Science
  • Machine Learning
  • Agentic AI
  • Python
  • Generative AI
  • LLMs
  • AI Solution Architecture

Key Responsibilities

  • Design scalable end-to-end AI and Machine Learning architectures for enterprise applications.
  • Architect and implement Data Science solutions using advanced ML and Deep Learning techniques.
  • Develop and optimize PyTorch-based models for predictive analytics, computer vision, NLP, and Generative AI use cases.
  • Design Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous planning, reasoning, tool usage, and workflow orchestration.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions.
  • Define architecture standards, development frameworks, and governance controls for AI initiatives.
  • Build and optimize data pipelines, feature stores, model training frameworks, and inference platforms.
  • Drive implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and intelligent workflow automation solutions.
  • Evaluate trade-offs among scalability, performance, accuracy, explainability, and cost.
  • Establish monitoring, observability, model governance, and responsible AI practices.
  • Partner with engineering teams to deploy AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and ethical AI requirements.
  • Mentor data scientists, ML engineers, and AI developers on architecture best practices.
  • Lead innovation initiatives focused on Generative AI, Agentic AI, and advanced machine learning capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI Solution Architecture.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in PyTorch and Deep Learning frameworks.
  • Extensive experience designing and deploying production-grade Machine Learning solutions.
  • Proven experience in Data Science methodologies, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics.
  • Strong understanding of Agentic AI architectures, AI agents, tool integration, and autonomous workflows.
  • Experience implementing RAG, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and Generative AI solutions.
  • Expertise in Python and AI/ML software development best practices.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management, and AI governance frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-based AI platforms and scalable AI infrastructure.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • TensorFlow Developer Certificate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
  • Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
  • Generative AI Professional Certifications

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to architect enterprise-scale AI and Agentic AI solutions.
  • Work with cutting-edge Machine Learning and Generative AI technologies.
  • Drive innovation in autonomous AI systems and intelligent automation.
  • Collaborate with global teams on high-impact business transformation initiatives.
  • Hybrid work model with excellent growth opportunities.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobDescription:
* THIS WOULD BE PAID INTERNSHIP FROM 2ND MONTH ONWARDS SUBJECT TO COMPLETION OF THE DELIVERABLES IN THE FIRST MONTH*



About the role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer Intern with solid foundations in machine learning and deep learning, with a strong focus on structured or tabular data. You will help build, evaluate, explain, and integrate predictive models using customer, transaction, financial, and operational datasets.


Key responsibilities


  • Clean and analyse tabular datasets, addressing missing values, outliers, categorical variables, and data quality issues.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering; build classification and regression models with clear baseline comparisons.
  • Develop and compare tree-based ensembles and neural networks for tabular prediction; package trained models for repeatable inference.
  • Design appropriate train, validation, and test splits; identify and prevent data leakage.
  • Evaluate models using suitable metrics, cross-validation, and error analysis.
  • Build reproducible Python pipelines for data preparation, training, and inference. Document experiments, explain predictions, and collaborate with developers to integrate models into applications.

Required skills


  • Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn; working knowledge of SQL and Git.
  • Good knowledge of probability, statistics, and core linear algebra.
  • Solid understanding of regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, and gradient boosting; hands-on experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost.
  • Solid understanding of neural networks, backpropagation, loss functions, optimisation, and regularisation; practical experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Understanding of feature encoding, class imbalance, overfitting, cross-validation, and model evaluation.
  • At least one end-to-end tabular ML project and experience training a neural network; these may be demonstrated in the same project.

Good to have


  • Exposure to tabular deep learning or foundation models such as TabNet, FT-Transformer, TabPFN, or TabICL.
  • Familiarity with SHAP, probability calibration, synthetic data generation, hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, or basic model deployment.
  • Interest in credit risk, customer propensity, churn, collections, or forecasting.

Eligibility


Students or recent graduates in Data Science, Computer Science, AI or ML, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.


Career progression


This internship offers a potential pathway to a full-time Machine Learning Engineer role. Interns who demonstrate strong technical skills, ownership, learning agility, and consistent contributions may be offered a full-time position upon successful completion, subject to performance and business requirements.

How to apply

Share your resume, GitHub or Kaggle links, and availability. Describe one tabular ML project, including the dataset, target, validation approach, evaluation metric, and your individual contribution.


Key skills

ML Engineering, Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Tabular Data, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, SQL, Feature Engineering, Model Inference
